verdicts.note: Direction is defensible relative to the incumbent but overstated as a position on the axis. Pole_b is 'outsider energy, generational change'; Lee is an insider whose own pamphlet case rests on three years as Chief Deputy Auditor, earlier roles as Payroll Deputy and Elections Specialist, and chairing the Capital Committee [S1][S3]. Her change pitch is about office management ('lacking transparency, responsiveness, and consistency'; 'rebuild trust and morale') [S1][S6], not new voices, and her endorsers are former office holders (former Auditor Henley, former Prosecuting Attorney Gaylord, Kevin Ranker) [S4][S5]. The evidence is mixed; keep +1 at low confidence. Summary and highlights check out against S1, S3, S4, S6 and S7; 'finance consultant to local districts and the Town of Friday Harbor' matches S1 and S7.

Score and confidence stand: first-term incumbent, Chief Deputy 2020-2023 and Auditor since 2023 [S1][S3], running on 'Experience. Integrity. Stability.' and 'a calm, steady hand' [S1][S3]; S4 lays out her record. One problem in the basis: the quote 'experience over uncertainty' does not appear anywhere in her dossier (S1-S6) and should be removed or sourced. Highlights check out against S1, S3, S4 and S5. Race blurb and office_does are supported by the contest file (S1, S3, S4, S5).
